hypotheses.C0_pair_splits_and_numerics_are_valid: Discovery and evaluation lexical pairs are disjoint, the pair-preserving shuffle has no fixed pair, and full native patches reconstruct with at least 0.95 median fidelity in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C1_context_edit_interaction_beats_additi: The interaction selector exceeds the additive selector by at least 0.05 causal fidelity with pair-bootstrap interval above zero in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C2_human_family_labels_improve_the_inter: Adding the declared semantic-family one-hot improves interaction-selector fidelity by at least 0.03 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C3_conditional_selection_beats_one_sided: Interaction selection exceeds the better of context-only and edit-only selection by at least 0.05 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C4_conditional_selection_is_useful_on_he: Interaction selection reaches at least 0.50 median causal fidelity and 0.15 endpoint-support Jaccard in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C5_exact_tensor_contraction_retains_a_ma: The exact midpoint tensor selector exceeds the learned interaction selector by at least 0.10 causal fidelity in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C6_fixed_family_banks_remain_weak: Fixed family-bank fidelity remains below 0.35 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C7_interaction_success_is_not_a_shuffled: Interaction selection exceeds a pair-preserving shuffled-target interaction model by at least 0.10 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C8_conditional_selector_transfers_out_of: For each layer, interaction-selector fidelity differs by at most 0.10 between FineWeb and TinyStories.
hypotheses.C9_exact_midpoint_reference_replicates: Exact midpoint selection reaches at least 0.70 median fidelity in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.C10_endpoint_oracle_is_high_fidelity: Endpoint-informed native rank-256 selection reaches at least 0.80 median fidelity in every layer/corpus cell.
